text: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.
Whoever kills a soul unless for a soul or for corruption done in the land — it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one — it is as if he had saved mankind entirely.

O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
The recompense for an injury is an injury equal thereto. But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation — his reward is due from Allah.
And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive, saying: We feed you only for the countenance of Allah.
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgment.
Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east or the west, but righteousness is in one who believes in Allah, gives wealth in spite of love for it, and establishes prayer.
